title: Cargo replaces a registry with another source
description: Cargo.toml declares a `replace-with` rule that redirects a registry to another source. Every crate from the replaced registry resolves through a different index, so its publication controls apply instead of the public registry's.
remediation: Document the mirror and serve it with a verified index, or remove the replacement.
limitation: It matches a `replace-with` rule that redirects a registry to another source in the parsed Cargo.toml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
